handler.description: The names the handler's side goes by in the real case's from and to fields: its people, teams and systems.

agent_message_matches.description: One entry per message the agent just sent: the real events that message corresponds to. Leave real_events empty when the real handler never did anything like it.

messages.description: Messages to deliver to the agent now, in order. Empty when nothing more would happen.

follows_events.description: Real event numbers this message is built from.

match.description: verbatim: exactly one real event delivered as it is (from, to, channel, body and attachments are then copied from that event). adapted: follows real events, reworded to fit the replay. partly_matched: the real case only partly covers it. not_in_real_case: a short reply the real case does not contain, such as saying they cannot help.

attachments.description: File names from the real case that this party actually sent.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences: which real events you are following, or why nothing is sent.
